subject: Computação
description_pt: Identificar o comportamento dos algoritmos no que diz respeito ao consumo de recursos como tempo de execução, espaço de memória e energia, entre outros

components.description_pt: Identificar o comportamento do tempo de execução de um algoritmo em função do tamanho da entrada
components.description_en: Identify the execution time behavior of an algorithm as a function of input size
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how different rates of change affect the behavior of a system

components.description_pt: Reconhecer como diferentes algoritmos variam no consumo de espaço em memória
components.description_en: Recognize how different algorithms vary in memory space consumption
components.cc_component_description: Describe how digitized information is stored in computer memory as binary data arrays

components.description_pt: Analisar o uso de energia associado à execução de um algoritmo
components.description_en: Analyze the energy use associated with running a given algorithm

components.description_pt: Comparar algoritmos com respeito às suas características de consumo de recursos
components.description_en: Compare algorithms with respect to their resource consumption characteristics

cc_matches.description: Change and rates of change can be quantified and modeled over very short or very long periods of time. Some system changes are irreversible.

Information can be digitized (e.g., a picture stored as the values of an array of pixels); in this form, it can be stored reliably in computer memory and sent over long distances as a series of wave pulses.
